annotations.title: Check a rent increase at renewal

description: Checks a Dubai rent renewal: the 90-day notice rule and the maximum increase under Decree 43 of 2013, with our median of new Ejari contracts as an approximate benchmark, every band as a scenario and the link to the official DLD Rental Index. Not legal advice.

area.description: Area name or slug: any of the Dubai areas from list_areas, e.g. "Dubai Marina", "jumeirah-village-circle", "JVC" or "Jumeirah Park".

building.description: Building name as registered with DLD (apartments), e.g. "Marina Gate 1". Optional.

expiry_date.description: Date the current contract ends, YYYY-MM-DD.

notice_date.description: Optional: date the notice of the change was received, YYYY-MM-DD.

segment.description: Optional: segment key from get_area_snapshot, instead of property_type and bedrooms.

name: rent_renewal_check
title: Check a rent increase at renewal
